subject.title: feat(dashboard): add unlisted OpenClaw Bay demo

question: Should the production dashboard Worker host this public-but-unlisted experimental Bay experience with bounded live-only terminal history?
rationale: Correctness review cannot decide whether the additional public hosted surface, visual product direction, and non-ledger semantics belong in the production dashboard.

options.title: Prove and sponsor
options.body: Require inspectable dynamic proof, then explicitly accept the public unlisted route and bounded live-only semantics.

options.title: Protect the preview
options.body: Require Cloudflare Access or application authentication before deployment.

options.title: Decline the hosted demo
options.body: Keep the production dashboard limited to the existing operational surfaces.

recommendation.title: Prove and sponsor
recommendation.body: Require inspectable dynamic proof, then explicitly accept the public unlisted route and bounded live-only semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The dashboard architecture and most central-file history trace to his commits, making him the strongest available owner for the rollout choice.
